description: Source code for the URLRequestThrottlerManager class, which manages request throttling based on URL and network changes in the Chromium project.

classes.name: URLRequestThrottlerManager
classes.description: Manages URL request throttling, handles network changes, and maintains URL entries for throttling logic.

methods.name: URLRequestThrottlerManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing URL request throttler manager, setting up URL replacements and network observers.

methods.name: ~URLRequestThrottlerManager
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up network observers and URL entries.

methods.name: RegisterRequestUrl
methods.description: Registers a URL request, normalizes URL, manages throttling entries, and handles localhost exceptions.

methods.name: OverrideEntryForTests
methods.description: Overrides a URL entry for testing purposes.

methods.name: EraseEntryForTests
methods.description: Removes a URL entry for testing.

methods.name: set_net_log
methods.description: Sets the network log for the throttler manager.

methods.name: OnIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Handles IP address change events by triggering network change handling.

methods.name: OnConnectionTypeChanged
methods.description: Handles network connection type changes by triggering network change handling.

methods.name: GetIdFromUrl
methods.description: Generates a normalized ID string from a URL for internal use.

methods.name: GarbageCollectEntriesIfNecessary
methods.description: Performs garbage collection of URL entries periodically based on request count.

methods.name: GarbageCollectEntries
methods.description: Removes outdated or excess URL entries to prevent unbounded growth.

methods.name: OnNetworkChange
methods.description: Clears all URL entries upon network change to reset throttling state.
